title: Solar Cell
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Solar
learningObjectives: Explain how a solar cell's power output depends on both cloud cover and the sun's angle above the horizon
Predict how the battery charge level responds as the sun arcs from horizon to zenith and back
Compare charging current against discharge current to determine whether the battery gains or loses charge
Trace the circuit path from solar cell through battery to the light load using the animated electron flow
Identify why peak solar generation occurs at midday when the sun is highest rather than at sunrise or sunset
